productionChanges.purpose: Correct pending-removal visibility exposed by same-tick cable replacement.

comparison.codecMeasurement: Actual production encoding of homogeneous enum collections and a mutable block position, plus a bulk SHA-256 output sink. Platform workers; no socket/network-bandwidth claim.
comparison.stressMeasurement: Same native pre/post tick boundary. Includes fixture-driven capability transactions and actual placed-machine/energy callbacks. Input/output maintenance after the boundary is excluded. Sprinting removes the 20 TPS ceiling.

limits: One workstation with ordinary OS/background activity; paired order and per-fork ranges are reported.
Synthetic automation load in an isolated IC2 server, not a measured FPS gain for the full modpack.
Shape/factory/type-cache changes do not alter recipe, voltage, loss or reactor arithmetic.
Exploratory invalid-codec and same-position-before-unregister runs are excluded from passing pressure statistics.

blockItemPlacement.scope: Placement-only subledger; aggregate item-use completion remains false by design. The alpha.8 508-item all-function ledger is historical evidence.

sameTickReplacementControl.interpretation: Alpha.8 has 56 expected immediate public-lookup failures after removal. Its later EU-continuation checks can recover. Alpha.9 passes both immediate lookup and actual EU continuation.

sustainedStability.interpretation: Only events inside the sustained measured stress phase; finite GC heap samples do not prove absence of all memory leaks.

historicalEvidence.note: The previous 508-item ledger and two-hour/two-client run remain alpha.8 evidence. Alpha.9 reruns the recorded targeted suites and finite native performance workload.
